_comment: Explicit, human-authored relevance judgments — written before any retrieval was run against this fixture, from reading benchmarks/graph-expand-retrieval/fixtures/docs/*.md directly. Keyed by (sourceFile, chunkIndex), which the offline dry-run of the real skeleton chunker (parseSkeleton + chunkFromSkeleton, no Qdrant) confirmed maps deterministically onto this fixture text. The 'irrelevant' lists were additionally cross-checked by hand-tracing src/core/storage/qdrant-adapter.js's getStructuralNeighbors() (section-sibling via parent_id, then prev/next via chunk_index window) against that same dry-run output, so every structural neighbor a real seed can surface is accounted for — not just the ones the fixture was originally designed around (e.g. cache-tuning.md#2 also surfaces as an irrelevant chunk_index-adjacent 'prev' neighbor of the q2/q4 seed section, not only as a section-sibling of the q1/q4 seed). Never derived from a search result.
